claim: The General Assembly meets every two years on the first Wednesday after the first Monday of January
quote: The General Assembly shall meet biennially on the first Wednesday next after the first Monday of January

claim: The governor has five days, Sundays excepted, to act; a bill becomes law without signature unless adjournment within three days of presentation prevents its return
quote: within five days (Sundays excepted) after it shall have been presented to the Governor, the same shall become a law in like manner as if the Governor had signed it

claim: Pocket veto rule
quote: unless the two Houses by their adjournment, within three days after the presentation of such bill shall prevent its return; in which case it shall not become a law

claim: Assistant judges, sheriffs, high bailiffs, state’s attorneys, probate judges and justices of the peace are elected at the November general election
quote: Assistant Judges of the County Court, Sheriffs, High Bailiffs, State’s Attorneys, Judges of Probate and Justices of the Peace, shall be elected biennially on the first Tuesday next after the first Monday of November

claim: Assistant judges are elected by district for four-year terms
quote: The Assistant Judges shall be elected by the voters of their respective districts as established by law. Their judicial functions shall be established by law. Their term of office shall be four years

claim: Sheriffs serve four-year terms
quote: Sheriffs shall be elected by the voters of their respective districts as established by law. Their term of office shall be four years

claim: State’s attorneys serve four-year terms
quote: State’s Attorneys shall be elected by the voters of their respective districts as established by law. Their term of office shall be four years

claim: Probate judges serve four-year terms
quote: Judges of Probate shall be elected by the voters of their respective districts as established by law

claim: Probate judge term
quote: The General Assembly may establish by law qualifications for the election to and holding of such office. Their term of office shall be four years

claim: Justices of the peace are elected by town, with the number set by population
quote: Justices of the Peace shall be elected by the voters of their respective towns

claim: Party members in each town nominate justice of the peace candidates by caucus
quote: may meet in caucus and nominate candidates for justice of the peace

claim: The primary is the second Tuesday in August in even-numbered years for major-party nominations, except justices of the peace and presidential offices
quote: A primary election shall be held on the second Tuesday in August in each even-numbered year for the nomination of candidates of major political parties

claim: A primary voter votes one party’s ballot and is not asked to state a party
quote: A voter shall vote for the candidates of one party only. A person voting at the primary shall not be required to indicate his or her party choice to any election official

claim: A plurality of a party’s primary vote wins the nomination
quote: A person who receives a plurality of all the votes cast by a party in a primary shall be a candidate of that party

claim: In the general election the candidate with the most votes is declared elected
quote: The canvassing committee shall declare the person receiving the largest number of votes for each office to be elected

claim: An independent candidate files a statement of nomination signed by voters qualified to vote for the office
quote: To constitute a valid nomination, a statement shall contain signatures of voters qualified to vote in an election for the office in question

claim: An independent may add up to three words of identification after their name
quote: a name, or other identification (in not more than three words) to be printed on the ballot following the candidate’s name

claim: Each town holds its annual meeting on the first Tuesday of March to elect officers
quote: A meeting of the legal voters of each town shall be held annually on the first Tuesday of March for the election of officers and the transaction of other business

claim: The annual meeting elects the town officers, including the moderator, clerk, treasurer and selectboard members
quote: At the annual meeting, a town shall choose from among its registered voters the following town officers

claim: A selectboard member is elected for three years by ballot each year (by default)
quote: One selectboard member for a term of three years who shall be elected by ballot

claim: A town may vote to make the clerk and treasurer appointed or give them three-year terms
quote: unless a town votes that the clerk shall be elected for a term of three years

claim: Australian ballot applies to a town’s meeting only if the town votes to use it
quote: the provisions of the Australian ballot system shall not apply to the annual or special meeting of a municipality unless that municipality, at its annual meeting or at a special meeting called for that purpose, votes to have them apply

claim: Under Australian ballot, municipal officers are nominated by petition, with any party endorsements filed alongside
quote: Nominations of the municipal officers shall be by petition. The petition shall be filed with the municipal clerk, together with the endorsement, if any, of any party or parties

claim: In those municipal elections the person with the most votes wins
quote: the person receiving the greatest number of votes for an office shall be declared elected to that office

claim: A municipality may propose a charter, or charter change, to the General Assembly after a local vote
quote: A municipality may propose to the General Assembly to adopt, repeal, or amend its charter by majority vote of the legal voters

claim: Municipality includes cities, towns, town school districts, incorporated school or fire districts and incorporated villages
quote: “Municipality” shall include a city, town, town school district, incorporated school or fire district, or incorporated village

claim: A local election means one for town or village officers in places over 4,000 people
quote: “Local election” shall mean any election of town or village officers in towns or villages having more than 4,000 inhabitants

claim: Vermont has 14 counties
quote: The State is divided into the counties of Addison, Bennington, Caledonia, Chittenden, Essex, Franklin, Grand Isle, Lamoille, Orange, Orleans, Rutland, Washington, Windham, and Windsor

claim: The assistant judges prepare the county budget each year
quote: Annually, the assistant judges shall prepare a proposed budget of the county for the ensuing year

claim: A village may be set up within a town on petition of its voters
quote: residing in a village containing 30 or more houses, the selectboard shall establish the bounds of such village

claim: Unorganized towns and gores are administered through state-appointed appraisers and supervisors
quote: a board of three appraisers for the unorganized towns and gores in each county

claim: The annual town meeting is the town school district meeting, which may move to a date between February 1 and June 15
quote: The annual town meeting shall be the annual town school district meeting

claim: School meeting date window
quote: so long as the meeting is held after February 1 and before June 15

claim: A town school district has a three-director board elected one a year for three years, unless it is part of a unified union district
quote: Each town school district shall have a school board consisting of three directors, one of whom shall be elected by ballot at each annual meeting of the town school district for a term of three years

claim: Act 73 of 2025 transforms education governance
quote: An act relating to transforming Vermont’s education governance, quality, and finance systems
